evidence.positive: Logged in as loopuser in headless Chromium (Playwright + CDP Network events) and opened /app-launch?patient_id=patient-1&case_id=case-3105&client_id=demo-demo&forceLaunch=true so AppLaunch mounted and preloadCommonMedicationAudioAnnouncements ran. First launch: 10 requests /audio/medications/<med>.mp3?v=10f82fe08 (the built SHA; grep of the live bundle index.WYelJArk.js shows mp3?v=10f82fe08), each 200 with Cache-Control: max-age=2592000, immutable, fromDiskCache=false; admin /actuator/metrics/http.server.requests?tag=uri:/audio/** COUNT went 5 -> 15. Second page.goto of the same URL and a page.reload: all 10 responses fromDiskCache=true, server COUNT stayed 15 -> 15 (no network request). Direct node http GET of /audio/medications/m-lidocaine.mp3?v=10f82fe08 -> 200, cache-control: max-age=2592000, immutable, last-modified: Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT.
evidence.negative: From the same app page fetched /audio/medications/m-lidocaine.mp3?v=deadbeef0 (a different release value on the same file): 200, fromDiskCache=false, server /audio/** COUNT 15 -> 16, i.e. a new release URL is downloaded again rather than served from the old release cache entry; a second fetch of that same URL was fromDiskCache=true with COUNT unchanged. Non-audio responses are not made immutable: GET /index.html and GET / -> Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate; GET /audio/medications/does-not-exist.mp3?v=10f82fe08 -> 404 with no-cache, no-store.
evidence.red_check: Compiled the parent commit (f1c955981^) version of StaticAssetCacheConfiguration (only the /static/** handler, no /audio/** handler) inside the container with javac 25 against /app/jib-classpath-file, adding one explicit slf4j WARN marker line in addResourceHandlers because the pre-fix class has no logger. Backed up the shipped class (sha256 5aa47f45...3952), copied the pre-fix class (sha256 670b6b7b...a8ec) over /app/classes/com/guided/orci/configuration/StaticAssetCacheConfiguration.class and docker-restarted the container. App log showed the marker line; GET of the versioned audio URL returned Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate, and the same browser probe went red: first launch, second launch and reload each produced 10 network downloads (fromDiskCache=false on all 30), and the /audio/** metric tag no longer existed (404) because no handler was registered. Reverted by copying the backup back (sha256 matched 5aa47f45...3952 in the container and in scratch), restarted, confirmed the marker line did not reappear, and re-ran the probe: Cache-Control: max-age=2592000, immutable, first launch 10 network / metric 1 -> 11, second launch 10 fromDiskCache / metric 11 -> 11.

red_check_signature: OR-3105 RED CHECK ACTIVE: pre-fix StaticAssetCacheConfiguration swapped in, no /audio/** resource handler registered
caveats: The after-a-deploy criterion was simulated by fetching the same file under a different ?v value, not by deploying a second release; that the bundle stamps the real SHA was confirmed by grepping the live bundle for mp3?v=10f82fe08.
Browser behaviour observed in headless Chromium only; the cache decision rests on max-age, which all browsers honour, and immutable only affects revalidation on reload.
The red-check log signature is a marker line added to the swapped-in pre-fix class, since neither version of StaticAssetCacheConfiguration logs anything on its own.
The loop image carries 17 stale index.*.js bundles from earlier builds alongside the live index.WYelJArk.js; an artefact of the non-clean loop build, not of this change.
Validated on the local throwaway build of main, not on dev as the acceptance criterion is worded.

automation.assessment: StaticAssetCacheConfigurationTest already locks the Cache-Control header for a versioned /audio/medications URL and the no-cache index.html via MockMvc, so the backend half is covered. Nothing asserts that the shipped bundle actually requests ?v=<sha> URLs or that a second launch skips the network; the webapp has no unit runner, so that belongs in a supplemental qa-suite launch test using CDP response flags, which is exactly what went red under the pre-fix class.
proposed_tests: qa-suite supplemental LAUNCH test: open app-launch, capture the 10 preload /audio/medications/*.mp3 responses, assert each URL ends in ?v=<non-empty release>, status 200 and Cache-Control max-age=2592000, immutable.

qa-suite supplemental LAUNCH test: navigate to app-launch a second time in the same context and assert every preload audio response reports fromDiskCache via a CDP Network session, with a different ?v value fetched from the page coming from the network.

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: Launching a demo case in headless Chromium fetched all ten preload audio files as ?v=10f82fe08 with Cache-Control max-age=2592000, immutable, and a second launch and a reload served all ten from the browser disk cache with the server request count unchanged.
Negative: The same file under a different ?v value was downloaded from the server again, and index.html and audio 404s stayed no-cache, no-store.
Red check: Swapping in the pre-fix StaticAssetCacheConfiguration and restarting made the audio responses no-cache, no-store and every relaunch re-downloaded all ten files, and restoring the shipped class (checksum verified) brought the cached behaviour back.

Automation: The MockMvc header test already exists, so a supplemental qa-suite launch test asserting the versioned preload URLs and the from-cache second launch is proposed.
